title: National Fund for Cultural Heritage Ordinance 1993

sections.shortTitle: National Fund for Cultural Heritage Ordinance 1993
sections.description:
Short title, extent and commencement

ORDINANCE XXXI OF 1993
NATIONAL FUND FOR CULTURAL HERITAGE ORDINANCE, 1993
1. Short title, extent and commencement.-(1) This
Ordinance may be called the National Fund for Cultural Heritage Ordinance,
1993.
(2) It extends to the whole of Pakistan.
(3) It shall come into force at once. '

sections.shortTitle: National Fund for Cultural Heritage Ordinance 1993
sections.description:
Definitions

ORDINANCE XXXI OF 1993
NATIONAL FUND FOR CULTURAL HERITAGE ORDINANCE, 1993
2. Definitions.-In this Ordinance, unless there is
anything repugnant in the subject or context,--
(a) "Board" means the Board of Governors set up
under section 6;
(b) "Fund" means the National Fund for Cultural
Heritage established under section 3; and
(c) "national heritage" means the
archaeological, architectural, historical and cultural heritage.

sections.shortTitle: National Fund for Cultural Heritage Ordinance 1993
sections.description:
Establishment of the Fund

ORDINANCE XXXI OF 1993
ORDINANCE XXXI OF 1993
NATIONAL FUND FOR CULTURAL HERITAGE ORDINANCE, 1993
3. Establishment of the Fund.-As soon as may be, after
the commencement of this Ordinance, the Federal Government shall establish the
National Fund for Cultural Heritage to carry out the purposes of this
Ordinance.

sections.shortTitle: National Fund for Cultural Heritage Ordinance 1993
sections.description:
Purposes and objectives of the Fund

ORDINANCE XXXI OF 1993
NATIONAL FUND FOR CULTURAL HERITAGE ORDINANCE, 1993
4. Purposes and objectives of the Fund.-(1) The primary
purpose of the Fund is to promote the conversation and preservation of national
heritage of Pakistan through various means, including financial and technical
assistance, and to create awareness amongst the people for appreciating and
preservation of archaeological, architectural, historical and cultural heritage
of Pakistan.
(2) In particular and without prejudice to the foregoing
purposes, the Fund shall be used to--
(a) undertake measures for preservation and conversation
of cultural heritage having archaeological, historical and architectural value;
(b) acquire or hold in lease any material and cultural
property or part thereof;
(c) provide assistance for preservation and maintenance
of a historical or archaeological monument or an archaeological site;
(d) create and strengthen cooperation and coordination
between international, national, provincial and regional organizations involved
in conservation and preservation of cultural heritage;
(e) provide financial and technical assistance towards
preservation of national heritage, and for furtherance of academic, scientific
and intellectual discourse on the subject relevant thereto;
(f) undertake promotional activities for enhancement of
resources of the fund; and
(g) undertake and promote research and arrangement
materials for publication of periodicals, monographs and publicity material,
including pamphlets, newspapers and posters in furtherance of the objectives of
the Ordinance.

sections.shortTitle: National Fund for Cultural Heritage Ordinance 1993
sections.description:
Sources of Fund

ORDINANCE XXXI OF 1993
NATIONAL FUND FOR CULTURAL HERITAGE ORDINANCE, 1993
5. Sources of Fund.--(1) The Fund shall be financed from
the following sources, namely:---
(a) grants from the Federal Government and Provincial
Governments;
(b) aid and assistance from local, national and
international agencies;
(c) contributions from the private organizations and
individuals; and
(d) income and earnings from the movable and immovable
properties acquired by, or leased to, the Fund.
(2) The amount credited to the Fund shall not lapse at
the end of a financial year and shall be available for utilization at any time.

(2) The members of the Board, other than ex officio

(3) The Secretariat of the Fund shall be at Islamabad and

(4) The Board may appoint an Executive Committee for
carrying out its functions as may be assigned to it by the Board.

sections.shortTitle: National Fund for Cultural Heritage Ordinance 1993
sections.description:
Exemption from tax

ORDINANCE XXXI OF 1993
NATIONAL FUND FOR CULTURAL HERITAGE ORDINANCE, 1993
7. Exemption from tax.--Notwithstanding anything
contained in the Income Tax Ordinance, 1979 (XXXI of 1979), all contributions
and donations to the Fund shall be exempt from levy of tax.

sections.shortTitle: National Fund for Cultural Heritage Ordinance 1993
sections.description:
Accounts of the Fund, etc

ORDINANCE XXXI OF 1993
NATIONAL FUND FOR CULTURAL HERITAGE ORDINANCE, 1993
8. Accounts of the Fund, etc.--(1) The accounts of the
Fund shall be audited by the Auditor-General of Pakistan.
(2) The Board may, from time to time, submit reports to the
Federal Government relating to the Fund and its activities.

Rules

NATIONAL FUND FOR CULTURAL HERITAGE ORDINANCE, 1993
9. Rules.-The Board may make rules for carrying out the
purposes of this Ordinance.
